title: From weighted paraboloid restriction to $k$-stars and distance graphs
summary: In this paper, we study pinned $k$-star distance sets associated to compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\geq 2$. For pins $x_1,\dots,x_k\in E$, the pinned $k$-star distance set is \[ Δ_{x_1,\dots,x_k}^{k\text{-star}}(E) = \{(|x_1-x|,\dots,|x_k-x|):x\in E\}\subset\mathbb{R}^k. \] We obtain improved Hausdorff-dimension thresholds on $E$ guaranteeing that pinned $k$-star distance sets have positive $k$-dimensional Lebesgue measure.
